Time = File Size / (Segment Size * Window Size)
Time = 350 Kbytes / (20 Kbytes * 32) = 350 / 640 = 0.546875 s = 546.875 ms.

Since RTT is 20ms, the total time is 546.875ms + 20ms = 566.875ms.
The time to receive the whole file is approximately 567ms.
